newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgians come bottom in Euro-condom league.
newsitem.headline: Belgians come bottom in Euro-condom league.

text.p: Sexually active Belgian men and women are the least frequent users of condoms in Europe, according to a survey published on Thursday by leading manufacturer Durex.

"The use of prophylactics in Belgium experienced its first growth following the first (AIDS) prevention campaigns in 1987, and has gently risen ever since," the company told a news conference in the Belgian capital.

"Nevertheless usage is low, and below all other European countries: 14.5 million condoms were sold in Belgium in 1996, that is an average of just over three per sexually active person per year," it added.

The firm produced a bar chart picking out a few key countries for comparison. This showed average annual use of four per year in the Netherlands, rising to 5.5 in Germany and France, 5.6 in Italy, 7.0 in Britain and 10.3 in Spain.
